## What will fight you

The T006 gear is ~4.08 mm outside diameter on a Ø0.79 mm bore — a **0.49 mm wall** at the tooth root, the single hardest feature in the machine. T012/T018/T024 are 0.83/0.78/0.71 mm. The original used a harder yellow metal for the tip gears. Enlarging them is **not** a free change: at fixed tooth count it changes the diametral pitch and breaks the shared DP-49.82 mesh with the cylinder gears.
